subject: Vendor packet & preferred payment path — HealthSync follow-up
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@healthsync.com>, Mike Tan <mike.tan@healthsync.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-01T14:32:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor packet & preferred payment path — HealthSync follow-up

Hi Sarah / Mike — thanks again for today’s call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement has a single place to act from: 

1) Vendor packet: I’m attaching our standard vendor packet (W-9, vendor info, banking instructions). If you prefer, we can also provide a shortened commercial packet for marketplace purchases.
2) Payment path options we covered:
   - Purchase order (net 30) via invoice sent to procure@healthsync.com
   - P-card (preferred by some product teams for low-touch trials)
   - Cloud marketplace (AWS/Azure/GCP) — requires registration in your marketplace portal, pricing and credits handled by the marketplace.

Please confirm which path you want for the initial pilot purchase and whether procurement will need Redwood to:
- Return a completed W-9 (US) or W-8 (non-US)
- Submit banking details for ACH/wire
- Enroll Redwood in HealthSync’s vendor portal (if yes, please share portal onboarding link and a contact)

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm payment path by EOD Thursday (8/3)
- Procurement requests docs; I upload completed files and set a DocuSign if needed
- Once vendor setup is complete, we move to invoice/PO kickoff and schedule a 1-week onboarding check-in

Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Packet.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — I’ll stand by to route any paperwork to Ben or Kim on our side.

— Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172
Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@healthsync.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Tan <mike.tan@healthsync.com>, procure@healthsync.com
Date: 2028-08-01T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor packet & preferred payment path — HealthSync follow-up

Hi Ava — appreciate the clear recap. A few quick answers: 

- For the pilot, procurement prefers a PO (net 30) to track spend. Please send invoices to procure@healthsync.com and include our PO number once we issue it.
- We need a completed W-9 on file. I attached our intake form for vendors (see Procurement Intake Form).
- Marketplace is something we may explore later, but not for the initial pilot.
- Portal: we do have a vendor portal. I’ll loop our vendor onboarding coordinator (mike) to send a registration link if we need Redwood to submit tax docs directly.

Next up from our side: procurement will issue a PO after they confirm Redwood’s bank details and W-9. We expect to generate the PO within 3–5 business days once we have the docs.

Thanks —
Sarah
Sarah Lopez
Head of Partnerships, HealthSync
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-02T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor packet & preferred payment path — finance checklist

Looping in our finance ops checklist to make sure we send exactly what HealthSync needs: 
- Confirmed: they want PO net 30 and completed W-9.
- Action for Ava: return signed W-9 (completed) + vendor remittance instructions (ACH routing + bank account name) — Ben will attach the bank stub we provide.
- If HealthSync insists on portal enrollment, Kim should receive the portal link and a contact email to complete vendor setup.

Ava — I’ll prepare Redwood_Vendor_Packet_final.pdf with bank stub and an internal cover sheet. Once you get the portal link or procurement intake PDF from Sarah, forward it and I’ll finalize.

— Ben Carter
Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>

Date: 2028-08-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Vendor packet & preferred payment path — docs attached

Hi Sarah / Procurement team — forwarding our final packet for intake. Per Ben’s note I attached: 
- Redwood_Vendor_Packet_final.pdf (includes completed W-9 and bank remittance stub)
- HealthSync_W9_Request-form.pdf (a copy for your portal intake)

Action items for procurement:
1) Confirm receipt and that the W-9 is acceptable for your vendor file.
2) Issue PO (we’ll reference HS-PO-######## on invoices).
3) If you prefer to enroll Redwood in your portal, send the enrollment link and the portal contact — Kim (cc’d) will complete the enrollment.

If procurement needs any additional attestations (data processing addendum, insurance certificate), say the word and I’ll route it. Looking forward to the pilot kick-off.

Thanks —
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
